verified.note: A published notice from the AT's Direção de Serviços de Registo de Contribuintes, on the authority's own information portal, announcing the move to the new NIF range. It states the structure — nine digits, the first eight sequential and the last a dígito de controlo — which is the shape this record's format encodes. The AT publishes no weights or modulus, so those parameters are conventional rather than cited.

note.en: The ninth digit is a modulus 11 over the eight before it, weighted 9 down to 2.
Electronic address for e-invoice routing: the EAS scheme code plus your identifier. Carry it now and the card is already correct when a counterparty moves to Peppol.
note.es: Dirección electrónica para el enrutamiento de facturas: el código de esquema EAS más tu identificador. Tenerlo ya deja la tarjeta lista cuando una contraparte pase a Peppol.

note.en: NIF on the receipt is routine and asked for at the till.
